---
title: "Adivina la brecha"
subtitle: "Un mini-juego sobre la brecha de género en el trabajo doméstico — ENUT Chile 2023"
toc: true
---

¿Qué tan bien calibrada tienes la intuición sobre la brecha de género en el trabajo doméstico no remunerado? Este juego te muestra cuatro grupos etarios, uno a la vez, y te pide adivinar cuánto tiempo más al día dedican las mujeres al trabajo doméstico, comparado con los hombres. Después de cada ronda te mostramos el valor real.

::: {.callout-note}
## Fuente de los datos
Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas (INE) de Chile, **II Encuesta Nacional sobre Uso del Tiempo (II ENUT) 2023**, personas de 15 años y más. Los promedios de horas diarias de trabajo doméstico no remunerado están ponderados por el factor de expansión de personas (`fe_cut`) — los mismos datos usados en la página [Trabajo pago y doméstico](paid-domestic-work.qmd).
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```
```{ojs}
function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = arr.slice();
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function getHours(activity, ageTab, sex) {
  const rec = durationRaw.find(d => d.activity === activity && d.age_tab === ageTab && d.sex === sex);
  return rec ? rec.hours : null;
}
function roundData(ageTab) {
  const hoursM = getHours("Trabajo doméstico", ageTab, "Mujeres");
  const hoursH = getHours("Trabajo doméstico", ageTab, "Hombres");
  const gapMin = Math.round((hoursM - hoursH) * 60);
  return { ageTab, hoursM, hoursH, gapMin };
}
function feedback(errorAbs, actualGap) {
  const pct = errorAbs / actualGap;
  if (pct <= 0.1) return { emoji: "🎯", text: "¡Exacto! Tu intuición está muy bien calibrada." };
  if (pct <= 0.25) return { emoji: "👏", text: "Muy cerca." };
  if (pct <= 0.5) return { emoji: "🤔", text: "No tan mal, pero hay una brecha entre tu intuición y el dato." };
  return { emoji: "😮", text: "Bastante lejos — la brecha real sorprende." };
}
function formatMin(min) {
  const hh = Math.floor(min / 60);
  const mm = min % 60;
  if (hh === 0) return `${mm} min`;
  return mm === 0 ? `${hh} h` : `${hh} h ${mm} min`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
game = {
  const wrapper = html`<div></div>`;
  const roundBox = html`<div></div>`;
  wrapper.appendChild(roundBox);

  let order = shuffle(ageTabOrder);
  let roundIndex = 0;
  let results = [];

  function renderRound() {
    roundBox.innerHTML = "";
    const ageTab = order[roundIndex];
    const data = roundData(ageTab);

    const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent);"></div>`;

    const progress = html`<div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #666); margin-bottom: 4px;">Ronda ${roundIndex + 1} de ${order.length}</div>`;
    const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 12px;">${ageTabLabel[ageTab]}</div>`;
    const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">¿Cuánto <strong>tiempo más al día</strong> dedican las <span style="color:${colorM}; font-weight:700;">mujeres</span> al trabajo doméstico no remunerado, comparado con los <span style="color:${colorH}; font-weight:700;">hombres</span>, en este grupo?</div>`;

    const inputRow = html`<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap;"></div>`;
    const hoursBox = html`<input type="number" min="0" max="5" step="1" value="1" style="width: 64px; padding: 4px; text-align: center;">`;
    const hLabel = html`<span>h</span>`;
    const minutesBox = html`<input type="number" min="0" max="55" step="5" value="0" style="width: 64px; padding: 4px; text-align: center;">`;
    const mLabel = html`<span>min</span>`;
    hoursBox.oninput = () => { if (hoursBox.value !== "") hoursBox.value = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.round(+hoursBox.value))); };
    minutesBox.oninput = () => { if (minutesBox.value !== "") minutesBox.value = Math.max(0, Math.min(59, Math.round(+minutesBox.value))); };
    inputRow.appendChild(hoursBox);
    inputRow.appendChild(hLabel);
    inputRow.appendChild(minutesBox);
    inputRow.appendChild(mLabel);

    const submitBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;">Comprobar</button>`;

    card.appendChild(progress);
    card.appendChild(group);
    card.appendChild(question);
    card.appendChild(inputRow);
    card.appendChild(submitBtn);
    roundBox.appendChild(card);

    submitBtn.onclick = () => {
      const guess = Math.max(0, (+hoursBox.value || 0) * 60 + (+minutesBox.value || 0));
      results.push({ ageTab, guess, actual: data.gapMin, hoursM: data.hoursM, hoursH: data.hoursH });
      renderReveal(data, guess);
    };
  }

  function renderReveal(data, guess) {
    roundBox.innerHTML = "";
    const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent);"></div>`;

    const progress = html`<div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #666); margin-bottom: 4px;">Ronda ${roundIndex + 1} de ${order.length}</div>`;
    const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 12px;">${ageTabLabel[data.ageTab]}</div>`;

    const errorAbs = Math.abs(guess - data.gapMin);
    const fb = feedback(errorAbs, data.gapMin);
    const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 16px;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Adivinaste <strong>${formatMin(guess)}</strong>, la brecha real es <strong>${formatMin(data.gapMin)}</strong> (te desviaste por ${formatMin(errorAbs)}).</div>`;

    // number line comparing guess vs actual
    const niceMax = Math.max(50, Math.ceil((Math.max(guess, data.gapMin) * 1.3) / 10) * 10);
    const svgWidth = 600, svgHeight = 100, x0 = 30, x1 = svgWidth - 30;
    const scale = v => x0 + (v / niceMax) * (x1 - x0);

    const lineHolder = html`<div style="overflow-x:auto;"></div>`;
    const svg = d3.select(lineHolder).append("svg").attr("width", svgWidth).attr("height", svgHeight).attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${svgWidth} ${svgHeight}`);

    svg.append("line").attr("x1", x0).attr("x2", x1).attr("y1", 60).attr("y2", 60).attr("stroke", "#999").attr("stroke-width", 1.5);
    const nTicks = 5;
    for (let i = 0; i <= nTicks; i++) {
      const v = Math.round((niceMax / nTicks) * i);
      const x = scale(v);
      svg.append("line").attr("x1", x).attr("x2", x).attr("y1", 56).attr("y2", 64).attr("stroke", "#999");
      svg.append("text").attr("x", x).attr("y", 78).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 10).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(formatMin(v));
    }

    const gx = scale(guess);
    svg.append("line").attr("x1", gx).attr("x2", gx).attr("y1", 30).attr("y2", 60).attr("stroke", "#888").attr("stroke-width", 2).attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,2");
    svg.append("circle").attr("cx", gx).attr("cy", 30).attr("r", 4).attr("fill", "#888");
    svg.append("text").attr("x", gx).attr("y", 20).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 11).attr("fill", "#888").text("Tu respuesta");

    const ax = scale(data.gapMin);
    svg.append("line").attr("x1", ax).attr("x2", ax).attr("y1", 30).attr("y2", 60).attr("stroke", accentColor).attr("stroke-width", 2.5);
    svg.append("circle").attr("cx", ax).attr("cy", 60).attr("r", 5).attr("fill", accentColor);
    svg.append("text").attr("x", ax).attr("y", 20).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 11).attr("fill", accentColor).attr("font-weight", 700).text("Real");

    // context bars: hours by sex
    const barsHolder = html`<div style="margin-top: 20px;"></div>`;
    const barsSvg = d3.select(barsHolder).append("svg").attr("width", svgWidth).attr("height", 90).attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${svgWidth} 90`);
    const maxHours = Math.max(data.hoursM, data.hoursH) * 1.15;
    const barScale = h => (h / maxHours) * (svgWidth - 140);
    const rows = [
      { label: "Mujeres", hours: data.hoursM, color: colorM, y: 10 },
      { label: "Hombres", hours: data.hoursH, color: colorH, y: 50 }
    ];
    rows.forEach(r => {
      barsSvg.append("text").attr("x", 0).attr("y", r.y + 15).attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(r.label);
      barsSvg.append("rect").attr("x", 90).attr("y", r.y).attr("width", barScale(r.hours)).attr("height", 22).attr("fill", r.color).attr("rx", 3);
      const hh = Math.floor(r.hours);
      const mm = Math.round((r.hours - hh) * 60);
      barsSvg.append("text").attr("x", 96 + barScale(r.hours)).attr("y", r.y + 15).attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(`${hh} h ${mm} min`);
    });

    const nextBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:20px;">${roundIndex + 1 < order.length ? "Siguiente ronda →" : "Ver resultado final"}</button>`;
    nextBtn.onclick = () => {
      if (roundIndex + 1 < order.length) {
        roundIndex += 1;
        renderRound();
      } else {
        renderSummary();
      }
    };

    card.appendChild(progress);
    card.appendChild(group);
    card.appendChild(fbBox);
    card.appendChild(lineHolder);
    card.appendChild(barsHolder);
    card.appendChild(nextBtn);
    roundBox.appendChild(card);
  }

  function renderSummary() {
    roundBox.innerHTML = "";
    const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent);"></div>`;

    const title = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 16px;">Resultado final</div>`;

    const table = html`<table style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px;"></table>`;
    const thead = html`<thead><tr>
      <th style="text-align:left; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #999;">Grupo</th>
      <th style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #999;">Tu respuesta</th>
      <th style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #999;">Real</th>
      <th style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #999;">Diferencia</th>
    </tr></thead>`;
    table.appendChild(thead);
    const tbody = html`<tbody></tbody>`;
    let totalError = 0;
    results.forEach(r => {
      const err = Math.abs(r.guess - r.actual);
      totalError += err;
      const row = html`<tr>
        <td style="padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">${ageTabLabel[r.ageTab]}</td>
        <td style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">${formatMin(r.guess)}</td>
        <td style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">${formatMin(r.actual)}</td>
        <td style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">${formatMin(err)}</td>
      </tr>`;
      tbody.appendChild(row);
    });
    table.appendChild(tbody);

    const avgError = Math.round(totalError / results.length);
    const closing = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">Tu error promedio fue de <strong>${formatMin(avgError)}</strong> por ronda. ${avgError <= 15 ? "Muy buena intuición sobre la brecha de género en el trabajo doméstico." : avgError <= 35 ? "Una intuición razonable, aunque la brecha real suele ser más marcada de lo que se piensa." : "La brecha real es más grande de lo que la mayoría intuye — así es la desigualdad en el trabajo doméstico no remunerado."}</div>`;

    const replayBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;">Jugar de nuevo</button>`;
    replayBtn.onclick = () => {
      order = shuffle(ageTabOrder);
      roundIndex = 0;
      results = [];
      renderRound();
    };

    card.appendChild(title);
    card.appendChild(table);
    card.appendChild(closing);
    card.appendChild(replayBtn);
    roundBox.appendChild(card);
  }

  renderRound();
  return wrapper;
}
```

::: {.callout-important}
El trabajo doméstico no remunerado es una de las brechas de género más marcadas y persistentes en el uso del tiempo: se mantiene en todos los grupos etarios, y no se explica solo por diferencias en la participación laboral remunerada — revisa la página [Trabajo pago y doméstico](paid-domestic-work.qmd) para más detalle.
:::

## Prueba otros estilos

La línea numérica de arriba es solo una forma de adivinar. Aquí tienes tres más, cada una con un grupo etario al azar — pruébalas y quédate con la que más te guste.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function randomAgeTab() {
  return ageTabOrder[Math.floor(Math.random() * ageTabOrder.length)];
}
function contextHoursBarsSvg(hoursM, hoursH) {
  const width = 380, height = 80;
  const holder = html`<div style="margin-top: 16px; text-align:left; max-width: 380px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;"></div>`;
  const svg = d3.select(holder).append("svg").attr("width", width).attr("height", height).attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
  const maxHours = Math.max(hoursM, hoursH) * 1.15;
  const barScale = h => (h / maxHours) * 190;
  const rows = [
    { label: "Mujeres", hours: hoursM, color: colorM, y: 8 },
    { label: "Hombres", hours: hoursH, color: colorH, y: 44 }
  ];
  rows.forEach(r => {
    svg.append("text").attr("x", 0).attr("y", r.y + 15).attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(r.label);
    svg.append("rect").attr("x", 80).attr("y", r.y).attr("width", 4).attr("height", 22).attr("fill", "#ddd");
    svg.append("rect").attr("x", 80).attr("y", r.y).attr("width", barScale(r.hours)).attr("height", 22).attr("fill", r.color).attr("rx", 3);
    const hh = Math.floor(r.hours);
    const mm = Math.round((r.hours - hh) * 60);
    svg.append("text").attr("x", 86 + barScale(r.hours)).attr("y", r.y + 15).attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(`${hh} h ${mm} min`);
  });
  return holder;
}
function retryButton(container, buildFn) {
  const btn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:16px;">Otro grupo →</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => { container.innerHTML = ""; buildFn(container); };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function buildGaugeDurationDemo(container) {
  const ageTab = randomAgeTab();
  const data = roundData(ageTab);
  const GMIN = 0, GMAX = 150;
  const R = 140, width = 2 * R + 100, height = R + 90;
  const cx = width / 2, cy = height - 55;

  function angleFor(v) {
    const t = Math.max(GMIN, Math.min(GMAX, v));
    return ((t - GMIN) / (GMAX - GMIN) - 0.5) * Math.PI;
  }
  function needlePoint(angle, len) {
    return [cx + Math.sin(angle) * len, cy - Math.cos(angle) * len];
  }

  const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); text-align:center;"></div>`;
  const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">${ageTabLabel[ageTab]}</div>`;
  const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 12px; max-width: 480px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">¿Cuánto <strong>tiempo más al día</strong> dedican las <span style="color:${colorM}; font-weight:700;">mujeres</span> al trabajo doméstico, comparado con los <span style="color:${colorH}; font-weight:700;">hombres</span>? Mueve la aguja.</div>`;

  const gaugeHolder = html`<div></div>`;
  const svg = d3.select(gaugeHolder).append("svg").attr("width", width).attr("height", height).attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`).style("max-width", "100%");
  const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${cx},${cy})`);
  const arcGen = (a0, a1, r0, r1) => d3.arc().innerRadius(r0).outerRadius(r1).startAngle(a0).endAngle(a1)();
  g.append("path").attr("d", arcGen(-Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, R - 16, R)).attr("fill", accentColor).attr("opacity", 0.2);
  g.append("path").attr("d", arcGen(-Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, R - 16, R)).attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", "#999").attr("stroke-width", 1);
  [GMIN, GMAX / 2, GMAX].forEach(v => {
    const a = angleFor(v);
    const [tx, ty] = needlePoint(a, R + 18);
    g.append("text").attr("x", tx - cx).attr("y", ty - cy).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 10).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(formatMin(v));
  });

  const needle = g.append("line").attr("x1", 0).attr("y1", 0).attr("x2", 0).attr("y2", -(R - 24)).attr("stroke", "#333").attr("stroke-width", 3).attr("stroke-linecap", "round");
  g.append("circle").attr("r", 5).attr("fill", "#333");
  const readout = svg.append("text").attr("x", cx).attr("y", cy - R * 0.45).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 20).attr("font-weight", 700).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(formatMin(0));

  let guessVal = 0;
  function setNeedle(v) {
    const a = angleFor(v);
    const [nx, ny] = needlePoint(a, R - 24);
    needle.attr("x2", nx - cx).attr("y2", ny - cy);
    readout.text(formatMin(v));
  }
  setNeedle(0);

  const slider = html`<input type="range" min="${GMIN}" max="${GMAX}" step="5" value="0" style="width: 100%; max-width: 420px;">`;
  slider.oninput = () => { guessVal = +slider.value; setNeedle(guessVal); };

  const submitBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top: 16px;">Comprobar</button>`;

  card.appendChild(group);
  card.appendChild(question);
  card.appendChild(gaugeHolder);
  card.appendChild(slider);
  card.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
  card.appendChild(submitBtn);
  container.appendChild(card);

  submitBtn.onclick = () => {
    slider.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.remove();
    const errorAbs = Math.abs(guessVal - data.gapMin);
    const fb = feedback(errorAbs, data.gapMin);
    const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 12px 0;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Adivinaste <strong>${formatMin(guessVal)}</strong>, la brecha real es <strong>${formatMin(data.gapMin)}</strong> (te desviaste por ${formatMin(errorAbs)}).</div>`;

    needle.attr("stroke", "#aaa").attr("stroke-width", 2).attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,2");
    readout.attr("fill", "#aaa");
    const realNeedle = g.append("line").attr("x1", 0).attr("y1", 0).attr("x2", 0).attr("y2", -(R - 24)).attr("stroke", accentColor).attr("stroke-width", 3.5).attr("stroke-linecap", "round");
    g.append("circle").attr("r", 4).attr("fill", accentColor);
    realNeedle.transition().duration(700).attrTween("x2", () => {
      const interp = d3.interpolateNumber(angleFor(guessVal), angleFor(data.gapMin));
      return t => needlePoint(interp(t), R - 24)[0] - cx;
    }).attrTween("y2", () => {
      const interp = d3.interpolateNumber(angleFor(guessVal), angleFor(data.gapMin));
      return t => needlePoint(interp(t), R - 24)[1] - cy;
    });

    card.appendChild(fbBox);
    card.appendChild(contextHoursBarsSvg(data.hoursM, data.hoursH));
    card.appendChild(retryButton(container, buildGaugeDurationDemo));
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function buildSeesawDurationDemo(container) {
  const ageTab = randomAgeTab();
  const data = roundData(ageTab);
  const GMAX = 150, MAXTILT = 20;
  const width = 420, height = 220;
  const pivotX = width / 2, pivotY = 150, beamHalf = 140;

  const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); text-align:center;"></div>`;
  const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">${ageTabLabel[ageTab]}</div>`;
  const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 16px; max-width: 480px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">¿Cuánto más pesa el trabajo doméstico de las mujeres frente al de los hombres, en tiempo? Inclina la balanza.</div>`;

  const holder = html`<div></div>`;
  const svg = d3.select(holder).append("svg").attr("width", width).attr("height", height).attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`).style("max-width", "100%");
  svg.append("path").attr("d", `M ${pivotX - 16},${pivotY + 40} L ${pivotX + 16},${pivotY + 40} L ${pivotX},${pivotY} Z`).attr("fill", "#999");
  svg.append("line").attr("x1", pivotX).attr("y1", pivotY + 40).attr("x2", pivotX).attr("y2", pivotY + 56).attr("stroke", "#999").attr("stroke-width", 4);

  const beamGroup = svg.append("g");
  beamGroup.append("line").attr("x1", pivotX - beamHalf).attr("y1", pivotY).attr("x2", pivotX + beamHalf).attr("y2", pivotY).attr("stroke", "#8a6d4a").attr("stroke-width", 8).attr("stroke-linecap", "round");
  beamGroup.append("text").attr("x", pivotX - beamHalf).attr("y", pivotY - 14).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 28).text("👨");
  beamGroup.append("text").attr("x", pivotX + beamHalf).attr("y", pivotY - 14).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 28).text("👩");
  beamGroup.append("circle").attr("cx", pivotX).attr("cy", pivotY).attr("r", 5).attr("fill", "#333");

  function angleFor(v) {
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(GMAX, v));
    return (t / GMAX) * MAXTILT;
  }
  function setTilt(v) {
    beamGroup.attr("transform", `rotate(${angleFor(v)} ${pivotX} ${pivotY})`);
  }
  setTilt(0);

  const readout = html`<div style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 8px;">${formatMin(0)}</div>`;

  let guessVal = 0;
  const slider = html`<input type="range" min="0" max="${GMAX}" step="5" value="0" style="width: 100%; max-width: 420px;">`;
  slider.oninput = () => {
    guessVal = +slider.value;
    setTilt(guessVal);
    readout.textContent = formatMin(guessVal);
  };

  const submitBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:16px;">Comprobar</button>`;

  card.appendChild(group);
  card.appendChild(question);
  card.appendChild(holder);
  card.appendChild(readout);
  card.appendChild(slider);
  card.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
  card.appendChild(submitBtn);
  container.appendChild(card);

  submitBtn.onclick = () => {
    slider.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.remove();
    const errorAbs = Math.abs(guessVal - data.gapMin);
    const fb = feedback(errorAbs, data.gapMin);
    const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 12px 0;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Adivinaste <strong>${formatMin(guessVal)}</strong>, la brecha real es <strong>${formatMin(data.gapMin)}</strong> (te desviaste por ${formatMin(errorAbs)}).</div>`;
    beamGroup.transition().duration(900).attrTween("transform", () => {
      const interp = d3.interpolateNumber(angleFor(guessVal), angleFor(data.gapMin));
      return t => `rotate(${interp(t)} ${pivotX} ${pivotY})`;
    });
    readout.textContent = formatMin(data.gapMin);
    readout.style.color = accentColor;
    card.appendChild(fbBox);
    card.appendChild(contextHoursBarsSvg(data.hoursM, data.hoursH));
    card.appendChild(retryButton(container, buildSeesawDurationDemo));
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
function buildThermoDurationDemo(container) {
  const ageTab = randomAgeTab();
  const data = roundData(ageTab);
  const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); text-align:center;"></div>`;

  const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">${ageTabLabel[ageTab]}</div>`;
  const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 16px; max-width: 480px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">Estima el <strong>tiempo diario</strong> que dedican mujeres y hombres al trabajo doméstico — la brecha se calcula sola.</div>`;

  const row = html`<div style="display:flex; gap: 40px; justify-content:center; align-items:flex-end; margin-bottom: 12px;"></div>`;

  function verticalSlider(label, color) {
    const col = html`<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px;"></div>`;
    const valLabel = html`<div style="font-weight:700; color:${color};">${formatMin(60)}</div>`;
    const slider = html`<input type="range" min="0" max="300" step="5" value="60">`;
    slider.style.cssText = `-webkit-appearance: slider-vertical; width: 32px; height: 160px; accent-color: ${color};`;
    const nameLabel = html`<div>${label}</div>`;
    col.appendChild(valLabel);
    col.appendChild(slider);
    col.appendChild(nameLabel);
    return { col, slider, valLabel };
  }

  const mCol = verticalSlider("Mujeres", colorM);
  const hCol = verticalSlider("Hombres", colorH);
  row.appendChild(mCol.col);
  row.appendChild(hCol.col);

  const gapReadout = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 12px;">Brecha implícita: <strong>${formatMin(0)}</strong></div>`;
  function updateGapReadout() {
    const g = (+mCol.slider.value) - (+hCol.slider.value);
    gapReadout.querySelector("strong").textContent = g >= 0 ? `${formatMin(g)} más` : `${formatMin(-g)} menos`;
  }
  mCol.slider.oninput = () => { mCol.valLabel.textContent = formatMin(+mCol.slider.value); updateGapReadout(); };
  hCol.slider.oninput = () => { hCol.valLabel.textContent = formatMin(+hCol.slider.value); updateGapReadout(); };

  const submitBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:8px;">Comprobar</button>`;

  card.appendChild(group);
  card.appendChild(question);
  card.appendChild(row);
  card.appendChild(gapReadout);
  card.appendChild(submitBtn);
  container.appendChild(card);

  submitBtn.onclick = () => {
    mCol.slider.disabled = true;
    hCol.slider.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.remove();
    const guessM = +mCol.slider.value, guessH = +hCol.slider.value;
    const guessGap = guessM - guessH;
    const errorAbs = Math.abs(guessGap - data.gapMin);
    const fb = feedback(errorAbs, data.gapMin);
    const guessDisp = guessGap >= 0 ? `${formatMin(guessGap)} más` : `${formatMin(-guessGap)} menos`;
    const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 12px 0;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Tu combinación implica <strong>${guessDisp}</strong>, la brecha real es <strong>${formatMin(data.gapMin)} más</strong> (te desviaste por ${formatMin(errorAbs)}).</div>`;
    card.appendChild(fbBox);
    card.appendChild(contextHoursBarsSvg(data.hoursM, data.hoursH));
    card.appendChild(retryButton(container, buildThermoDurationDemo));
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function buildRaceDurationDemo(container) {
  const ageTab = randomAgeTab();
  const data = roundData(ageTab);
  const GMAX = 150;

  const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); text-align:center;"></div>`;
  const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">${ageTabLabel[ageTab]}</div>`;
  const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 16px; max-width: 480px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">Apuesta cuántos <strong>minutos más</strong> sigue corriendo el cronómetro de las <span style="color:${colorM}; font-weight:700;">mujeres</span> después de que se detiene el de los <span style="color:${colorH}; font-weight:700;">hombres</span> — luego dale a correr y mira quién llega primero.</div>`;

  let guessVal = 0;
  const readout = html`<div style="font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px;">${formatMin(0)}</div>`;
  const slider = html`<input type="range" min="0" max="${GMAX}" step="5" value="0" style="width: 100%; max-width: 420px;">`;
  slider.oninput = () => { guessVal = +slider.value; readout.textContent = formatMin(guessVal); };

  function stopwatchRow(label, color) {
    const row = html`<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-bottom: 10px;"></div>`;
    const nameTag = html`<div style="width:70px; text-align:left; font-weight:700; color:${color};">${label}</div>`;
    const track = html`<div style="flex:1; height:16px; background:color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden;"></div>`;
    const fill = html`<div style="height:100%; width:0%; background:${color}; border-radius:8px;"></div>`;
    track.appendChild(fill);
    const timeLabel = html`<div style="width:110px; text-align:right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight:700;">0 min</div>`;
    row.appendChild(nameTag);
    row.appendChild(track);
    row.appendChild(timeLabel);
    return { row, fill, timeLabel };
  }

  const raceHolder = html`<div style="max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto 12px;"></div>`;
  const mRow = stopwatchRow("Mujeres", colorM);
  const hRow = stopwatchRow("Hombres", colorH);
  raceHolder.appendChild(mRow.row);
  raceHolder.appendChild(hRow.row);

  const startBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:8px;">Iniciar carrera ▶</button>`;

  card.appendChild(group);
  card.appendChild(question);
  card.appendChild(readout);
  card.appendChild(slider);
  card.appendChild(raceHolder);
  card.appendChild(startBtn);
  container.appendChild(card);

  startBtn.onclick = () => {
    slider.disabled = true;
    startBtn.disabled = true;
    startBtn.textContent = "Corriendo...";

    const totalM = data.hoursM * 60, totalH = data.hoursH * 60;
    const maxTotal = Math.max(totalM, totalH);
    const DURATION_MS = 3200;
    const rate = maxTotal / DURATION_MS;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    let hFlagged = false;

    function frame(now) {
      const elapsed = now - t0;
      const simMin = Math.min(elapsed * rate, maxTotal);
      const mVal = Math.min(simMin, totalM);
      const hVal = Math.min(simMin, totalH);
      mRow.fill.style.width = (mVal / maxTotal * 100) + "%";
      hRow.fill.style.width = (hVal / maxTotal * 100) + "%";
      mRow.timeLabel.textContent = formatMin(Math.round(mVal));
      if (hVal >= totalH && !hFlagged) { hFlagged = true; }
      hRow.timeLabel.textContent = formatMin(Math.round(hVal)) + (hFlagged ? " 🏁" : "");
      if (simMin < maxTotal) {
        requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      } else {
        finish();
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);

    function finish() {
      startBtn.remove();
      const errorAbs = Math.abs(guessVal - data.gapMin);
      const fb = feedback(errorAbs, data.gapMin);
      const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 16px 0;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Apostaste <strong>${formatMin(guessVal)}</strong>, la diferencia real es <strong>${formatMin(data.gapMin)}</strong> (te desviaste por ${formatMin(errorAbs)}).</div>`;
      card.appendChild(fbBox);
      card.appendChild(contextHoursBarsSvg(data.hoursM, data.hoursH));
      card.appendChild(retryButton(container, buildRaceDurationDemo));
    }
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
templateGalleryDuration = {
  const wrapper = html`<div id="template-gallery-duration"></div>`;
  const tabBar = html`<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom: 16px;"></div>`;
  const demoBox = html`<div></div>`;
  wrapper.appendChild(tabBar);
  wrapper.appendChild(demoBox);

  const templates = [
    { id: "gauge", label: "Medidor", build: buildGaugeDurationDemo },
    { id: "seesaw", label: "Balanza", build: buildSeesawDurationDemo },
    { id: "thermo", label: "Termómetros", build: buildThermoDurationDemo },
    { id: "race", label: "Carrera de cronómetros", build: buildRaceDurationDemo }
  ];

  let active = "gauge";
  const buttons = templates.map(t => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.textContent = t.label;
    b.style.cssText = "padding:6px 16px;margin:0 4px 8px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.9rem;";
    b.onclick = () => { active = t.id; refresh(); };
    tabBar.appendChild(b);
    return { btn: b, id: t.id };
  });

  function updateButtons() {
    buttons.forEach(({ btn, id }) => {
      const on = id === active;
      btn.style.background = on ? "#5c9e95" : "white";
      btn.style.color = on ? "white" : "#333";
    });
  }

  function refresh() {
    updateButtons();
    demoBox.innerHTML = "";
    templates.find(t => t.id === active).build(demoBox);
  }

  refresh();
  return wrapper;
}
```

## Cómo se hizo esta página

1. Usa los mismos datos que [Trabajo pago y doméstico](paid-domestic-work.qmd): la ENUT 2023 de Chile, procesada con [`scripts/build_paid_domestic_clock.py`](https://github.com/vvaldiviamedina/vvaldiviamedina.github.io/blob/main/scripts/build_paid_domestic_clock.py) (o su equivalente en R).
2. El juego principal — rondas, línea numérica comparando adivinanza vs. valor real, resumen final — está escrito directamente en [Observable JS](https://observablehq.com/), sin librerías externas, manipulando el DOM de forma imperativa (igual que los relojes y la rueda de la página anterior).
3. La sección "Prueba otros estilos" incluye tres bocetos adaptados de [Adivina la brecha: participación](guess-the-participation-gap.qmd) — medidor, balanza y termómetros dobles — más uno nuevo, pensado específicamente para tiempo: una carrera de cronómetros animada con `requestAnimationFrame`, donde el de las mujeres sigue corriendo después de que se detiene el de los hombres.
